texts.label: text
texts.orig: OpenHands Agent Canvas turns your coding agents into a self-hosted, always-on engineering team. It's a developer control center for starting conversations and automating everyday tasks - like generating reports that publish to Slack or automatically decomposing GitHub issues into tasks.
texts.text: OpenHands Agent Canvas turns your coding agents into a self-hosted, always-on engineering team. It's a developer control center for starting conversations and automating everyday tasks - like generating reports that publish to Slack or automatically decomposing GitHub issues into tasks.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: It runs locally on your machine by default, but can connect to multiple "agent backends", e.g. running agents in Docker containers, on VMs, or within your company infrastructure. You can optionally choose to run agents on OpenHands Cloud or OpenHands Enterprise infrastructure.
